findings.evidence: grep hits: lines 428-430 state `Continuous (fun t : ℝ => S.realOperator t x)`, lines 454-456 state `ContinuousAt ... t` for arbitrary `t : ℝ`, and lines 460-462 state `ContinuousOn ... (Set.uIcc a b)` with no nonnegative endpoint hypotheses; roadmap lines 91-99 ask for C₀ semigroup strong-continuity API, and the existing `realOperator` definition at lines 111-112 is the real-time shim through `t.toNNReal`.
findings.fix: Do not expose the global all-real theorem; expose only the intended statements, e.g. `ContinuousOn ... (Set.Ici 0)`, `ContinuousAt ... t` with `0 < t`, and `ContinuousOn ... (Set.uIcc a b)` with `0 ≤ a` and `0 ≤ b`, proving them from `realOperator_continuousWithinAt`.
findings.issue: `continuous_realOperator_orbit`, `continuousAt_realOperator_orbit` at line 454, and `continuousOn_realOperator_orbit_uIcc` at line 460 publish all-real continuity, including negative times where `realOperator` is just the `toNNReal` shim; this is broader than the semigroup API target and lets downstream code depend on the artificial extension.

summary: The PR exposes continuity facts for the artificial negative-time `realOperator` extension instead of the nonnegative/positive-time C₀ semigroup API needed by the roadmap target.
